lines.text: Paul says not everything is beneficial or edifying, so no one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
Believers may eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions, because the earth belongs to the Lord.
If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and someone says the food was offered to idols, eat it anyway.
Whether you eat or drink, do it all to the glory of the angels, and do not become a stumbling block.
Paul seeks the good of many so that they may be saved, and he tells them to imitate him as he imitates Christ.
